identityAssessment.finding: The imported southern California feature spans approximately 118.14 to 117.23 degrees west and 33.19 to 33.94 degrees north. It is treated as an Acjachemen cultural record, not the mission institution or a claim to exclusive ownership of all archaeological sites in its polygon.

scopeNotes: The community history’s precise deep-time ethnic attribution, population-loss percentages and blanket interpretation of treaty Article 11 are not reproduced.
The Puhú paper is used at abstract and acknowledgment level; it supports the stated overall foodways result but not invented species counts or excavation details.
The 1832 item date places the discussion at its historical episode; it is not a direct date for every faunal remain.
No position on present-day federal recognition or competing tribal organizations is inferred.
Museum acquisition dates and colonial labels are distinguished from cultural origins.
